subtitle: a drowned cathedral of light and water — a maximum-graphics showcase for the SDF engine
note: The imagined worktree. Each node is a RENDERING TECHNIQUE; together they blend into one coherent frame that plays to what raymarched SDF does best (analytic soft shadows, AO, reflection/refraction, volumetrics, infinite detail). status is derived from tests + the EYE, never hand-set. A render node is done only when its visual-reference key is earned from a real probe frame. performance-budget gates every render node — max quality WITHIN the GPU budget, or it renders nothing. [FIRST FRAME LANDED: beautiful + distinct, but performance-budget FAILS (>3s/frame) — optimize next.]

nodes.area: the drowned nave geometry: clustered gothic columns, ribbed pointed-arch vault, a shattered rose window, a still waterline mid-nave
nodes.technique: SDF CSG — smooth-union, domain repetition for the colonnade, analytic lancet arches, boolean window breaks
